messages.content: There’s now a welcome dinner Friday at 7:30 p.m. on the riverfront. Can we make that comfortably after landing, even if the room is not ready? I also want the bag plan and Monday airport timing nailed down without changing either flight or the Forsyth reservation.

Yes. Your flight lands at 2:18 p.m. Friday. Allowing about 30 minutes to deplane and collect both suitcases, then 25-35 minutes by car, you should reach Forsyth Park Inn around 3:20 p.m. If the king room is not ready before published check-in, the desk can hold both bags.
Please confirm they will take both bags before check-in, not just note it as a possibility.

Confirmed with the inn: the front desk will store both suitcases on Friday before the room is available. I added that arrival-day request to FPI-6209446; the existing Monday storage note remains attached as well.
Good. What time should we leave for dinner? I don’t want the plan to depend on a perfectly quick ride.

Plan to be ready in the lobby at 6:40 p.m. and request the car then. A Forsyth Park-to-riverfront ride is commonly about 15 minutes, but allowing 30-35 minutes for pickup and traffic gets you there around 7:10-7:15, with time to find the restaurant before 7:30.
And Monday? We check out at eleven, but I don’t want to cut the airport close just because the bags can be stored.

For the 1:35 p.m. flight, I would check out by 10:45 a.m., collect both suitcases immediately, and request a car for 11:00. With roughly 25-35 minutes to Savannah airport, you should arrive around 11:30, about two hours before departure. The storage note still covers you if checkout finishes earlier, but there is no reason to leave the bags for long.
Please consolidate the weekend with those windows. Everything already booked stays as it is.

Friday: depart Denver at 8:20 a.m., connect in Atlanta, and arrive Savannah at 2:18 p.m. Collect both suitcases and reach Forsyth Park Inn at about 3:20; if the room is not ready, leave both bags at the desk. Be in the lobby at 6:40, request a car, and aim to reach the riverfront by 7:15 for the 7:30 welcome dinner. Saturday: ceremony near Forsyth Park at 4:00 p.m. Sunday: riverfront brunch at 11:00 a.m. Monday: check out by 10:45, retrieve both bags, and leave around 11:00 for the 1:35 p.m. flight; arrival in Denver remains 5:58 p.m. Both flights under D7K4QP and the three-night king room for two adults under FPI-6209446 remain unchanged.
